theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_stab_energy_convergence
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (F : ℕ → Fin P → Euclid P → ℝ) (G : Fin P → Euclid P → ℝ), (∀ k j, AEStronglyMeasurable (F k j) μ) → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (G j) μ) → (∀ k, Integrable (fun x => ∑ j : Fin P, (F k j x) ^ 2) μ) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ j : Fin P, (F k j x - G j x) ^ 2) ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) → Integrable (fun x => ∑ j : Fin P, (G j x) ^ 2) μ ∧ Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, ∑ j : Fin P, (F k j x) ^ 2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, ∑ j : Fin P, (G j x) ^ 2 ∂μ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
